# Token reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-token-docs.py from base/base.css. Do not edit by hand. -->

A skin is a token file, `skin.css`, that sets `--ts-*` custom properties on `html.dark`. There are 301 tokens. Every one has a default in `base/base.css`, so a skin sets only what it wants to change. Setting the 20 core roles is enough for a complete skin: the rest are derived from them. See `examples/minimal/skin.css`.

A skin may also define its own palette as `--p-*` properties and refer to them from its token values. Nothing else is allowed in a token file (docs/PLUGIN.md, "The token file").

## Core roles

A skin normally sets these; the defaults are stock LibreNMS dark.

| Token | Default | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| `--ts-bg` | `#272b30` | Page background. |
| `--ts-surface` | `#2e3338` | Panels, widgets, dropdowns, modals. |
| `--ts-surface-raised` | `#3e444c` | Headings, table heads, buttons, the navbar. |
| `--ts-surface-hover` | `#484f57` | Hovered and selected rows, links, menu items. |
| `--ts-border` | `#1f2226` | Borders and dividers. |
| `--ts-text` | `#c8c8c8` | Body text. |
| `--ts-text-dim` | `#a4a9ae` | Secondary text: navbar links, footers, pagination. |
| `--ts-text-mute` | `#8a9097` | Least prominent text: placeholders, help text, disabled items. |
| `--ts-text-bright` | `#f5f6f7` | Headings and text on coloured backgrounds. |
| `--ts-accent` | `#5a9fd4` | The skin's signature colour: active tabs, hover edges, modal tops. |
| `--ts-link` | `#8ab4d8` | Links. |
| `--ts-highlight` | `#66afe9` | Focus rings and hover edges on inputs and menus. |
| `--ts-success` | `#5cb85c` | Up, OK. |
| `--ts-warning` | `#f0ad4e` | Warning. |
| `--ts-danger` | `#d9534f` | Down, error. |
| `--ts-info` | `#5bc0de` | Informational, and primary buttons by default. |
| `--ts-danger-text` | `#ff6b64` | Readable red for text on dark surfaces (device-down links). |
| `--ts-font-display` | `Verdana, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif` | Headings, navbar, panel titles, buttons. |
| `--ts-font-mono` | `"DejaVu Sans Mono", Consolas, "SF Mono", Menlo, ui-monospace, monospace` | Data: table cells, labels, hostnames. |
| `--ts-radius-sm` | `4px` | Corner radius; the other radii default to it. |

## Derived roles

Default to a mix of the core roles.

| Token | Default | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| `--ts-brand` | `var(--ts-accent)` | `.navbar-default .navbar-brand` color |
| `--ts-nav-accent` | `var(--ts-accent)` | `.navbar-default .navbar-nav > li > a:hover (+4)` color |
| `--ts-nav-icon-hover` | `var(--ts-highlight)` | `.navbar-nav > li > a:hover .fa-nav-icons (+1)` color |
| `--ts-font-label` | `var(--ts-font-display)` | `.dropdown-menu > li > a` font-family; `.alert` font-family |
| `--ts-radius-lg` | `var(--ts-radius-sm)` | `.panel (+1)` border-radius; `.modal-content` border-radius |
| `--ts-panel-title` | `var(--ts-text-bright)` | `.panel-default > .panel-heading (+1)` color; `.panel-title (+4)` color; `.widget-header` color; +2 more |
| `--ts-button-bg` | `var(--ts-surface-raised)` | `.btn-default (+1)` background-color |
| `--ts-addon-text` | `var(--ts-text-dim)` | `.input-group-addon` color |
| `--ts-radius-md` | `var(--ts-radius-sm)` | `.alert` border-radius; `.gs-w (+1)` border-radius |
| `--ts-bevel` | `inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .05), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, .4)` | `.alert` box-shadow; `.graph-image (+1)` box-shadow; default of `btn-danger-shadow` |
| `--ts-danger-deep` | `color-mix(in srgb, var(--ts-danger) 22%, var(--ts-bg))` | `.alert-danger` background-color; `.panel-danger > .panel-heading` background; `.bg-danger` background-color; +7 more; default of `btn-danger-bg` |
| `--ts-success-deep` | `color-mix(in srgb, var(--ts-success) 22%, var(--ts-bg))` | `.alert-success` background-color; `.panel-success > .panel-heading` background; `.bg-success` background-color; +7 more; default of `btn-success-bg` |
| `--ts-warning-deep` | `color-mix(in srgb, var(--ts-warning) 22%, var(--ts-bg))` | `.alert-warning` background-color; `.panel-warning > .panel-heading` background; `.table > thead > tr.warning > td (+5)` background-color; +2 more |
| `--ts-info-deep` | `color-mix(in srgb, var(--ts-info) 22%, var(--ts-bg))` | `.alert-info` background-color; `.panel-primary > .panel-heading` background; `.panel-info > .panel-heading` background; +6 more; default of `btn-primary-bg` |
| `--ts-badge-alert` | `var(--ts-danger)` | `.badge-navbar-user.badge-danger` background-color |
| `--ts-progress` | `var(--ts-accent)` | `.pace .pace-activity` border-left-color; default of `progress-bar-bg`, `progress-glow-shadow`, `progress-glow-shadow` |
| `--ts-code-text` | `var(--ts-highlight)` | `pre (+1)` color |
| `--ts-font-code` | `var(--ts-font-mono)` | `pre (+1)` font-family |

## Shared effects

Used by the defaults below.

| Token | Default | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| `--ts-shadow` | `0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4)` | default of `navbar-shadow`, `navbar-dropdown-shadow`, `panel-shadow`, `widget-shadow` |
| `--ts-recess` | `inset 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, .5)` | default of `input-shadow`, `input-focus-shadow`, `well-shadow`, `pre-shadow` |
| `--ts-sunken` | `color-mix(in srgb, var(--ts-bg) 75%, #000)` | default of `input-bg`, `well-bg`, `pre-bg`, `scrollbar-color` … |
| `--ts-on-accent` | `#111` | default of `btn-warning-fg` |
